name: Yas Marina Circuit
summary: The usual season finale: an island track that races from sunset into the night, with a hotel over the circuit.
character: The race starts at sunset and finishes under floodlights. The 2021 rework took out slow chicanes to help overtaking.

corners.name: Turn 5 (old Turn 7 hairpin)
corners.note: Hairpin at the end of the first long straight. The main overtaking spot.

corners.name: Turn 9 (old Turns 11-14)
corners.note: A banked left that replaced a run of slow chicanes in 2021.

moments.title: Decided on the last lap
moments.body: After a late safety car restart, Max Verstappen passed Lewis Hamilton on the final lap to win his first title. Race director Michael Masi was replaced after the season.

history.body: First race, and F1's first race that started in daylight and finished at night.
